title: suggest_emojis input
description: Text to suggest emojis for, plus how many suggestions to return. The text length bound is counted in Unicode code points; empty or whitespace-only text is refused as invalid input.

text.description: The text to suggest emojis for, counted in Unicode code points ([...text].length), 1..1024. Empty or whitespace-only text is refused.

limit.description: How many suggestions to return: the top labels by descending probability. Defaults to 5.
